verdict.rationale: Milvus is a vector database, and a database could plausibly offer in-product AI insights, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only building blocks: an official MCP server that lets external AI applications query Milvus with natural language, plus vector search primitives. Neither is an in-product feature that generates insights or suggestions from the user's data, so no credit is given.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
